question: Related Questions Q. Assalamualaikum 1-My student wants to know the meaning of a dream. He saw a dream that there were alot of spiders (dangerous and non dangerous) and spider webs in his room,he killed most of the spiders and some were left to kill then he woke up what does the dream mean? 1620 views Q. Suppose, I saw a dream and asked three different Scholars/Mufti for the Interpretation/Tabeer of my dream and all of them interpreted my dreams with different meanings, so what interpretation should I consider? the interpretation given by the first Scholar or the interpretation which seems to be more positive/best to me? 3265 views Q. So he has also took up his sword than I wake up as I was very much afraid. 1503 views Q. having intercourse 2308 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. 1519 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 47204 Country: United Kingdom Title: Ulama and Akabir Question: I am writing to tell you that I have seen many Akabir in my dream, Syed Ataullah Shah and Qari Haneef Multani. Apart from these I have seen Maulana Zakariya's famous student Maulana Yusuf Motala sb. I have also seen my ustad and the imam of our masjid many times in my dream. But last night I saw Mufti Ismail Menk and his brother Mufti Shabbir Menk who are the sons of Maulana Musa Menk. Maulana Musa Menk is Maulana Zakariya’s student as well as Maulana Maseehullah Khan’s friend. When I saw Mufti Ismail Menk and Mufti Shabbir Menk they came with other Ulama to meet me. I am only 17 yet. I am not an Alim. I am only becoming a Hafiz. Yet these Ulama did tareef of me in front of many people. Also one brother had a dream I was the muazzin of Masjid Nabwi and I had a dream the imam of our masjid was the imam of masjid Nabwi. Please could you interpret these dreams? Also make dua for me. I love the Deoband and I do dua to Allah that he makes me a graduate of Darul Uloom Deoband. Answer ID: 47204 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1577/1171/H=11/1434) Ma-shaAllah, your dream is very nice. In-shaAllah, you shall receive full benefit from religious services and holy places as well the blessings of both the worlds. (2) May Allah fulfil all your lawful desires and may you graduate from Darul Uloom Deoband with ease. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
